info.title: Showpass Organizer Inventory API

ProductPermissionTypeEnum.description:
* `allow_all` - Include for all items
* `include` - Include for certain items
* `exclude` - Exclude for certain items

SaleEndsOnDefaultOptionEnum.description:
* `two_weeks_before_event` - Two weeks before event starts
* `ten_days_before_event` - Ten days before event starts
* `one_week_before_event` - One week before event starts
* `five_days_before_event` - Five days before event starts
* `two_days_before_event` - Two days before event starts
* `day_before_event` - One day before event starts
* `four_hour_before_event` - Four hours before event starts
* `two_hour_before_event` - Two hours before event starts
* `hour_before_event` - One hour before event starts
* `thirty_minutes_before_event` - Thirty minutes before event starts
* `thirty_minutes_after_event` - Thirty minutes after event starts
* `start_of_event` - Start of the event
* `end_of_event` - End of the event
* `one_before_event_end` - One hour before the event ends
* `two_before_event_end` - Two hours before the event ends

ShippingPricingMethodEnum.description:
* `sp_per_item` - Per item
* `sp_per_ticket_item_group` - Per item group type
* `sp_flat_rate` - Flat rate
